using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Net.Http;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.HuggingFace;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.ImageToText;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.HuggingFace.UnitTests;

public class HuggingFaceServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void AddHuggingFaceImageToText_WithModel_RegistersServiceWithCorrectLoggerFactory()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var loggerFactory = new LoggerFactory();
        services.AddSingleton<ILoggerFactory>(loggerFactory);

        // Act
        services.AddHuggingFaceImageToText("test-model");

        // Assert - Build and resolve to trigger factory execution
        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var imageService = serviceProvider.GetKeyedService<IImageToTextService>(null);

        // Verify the service was registered (factory was called with IServiceProvider)
        Assert.NotNull(imageService);
        Assert.IsType<HuggingFaceImageToTextService>(imageService);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddHuggingFaceImageToText_WithModelAndEndpoint_RegistersServiceWithCorrectLoggerFactory()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var loggerFactory = new LoggerFactory();
        services.AddSingleton<ILoggerFactory>(loggerFactory);

        // Act
        services.AddHuggingFaceImageToText(new Uri("https://test-endpoint.com"));

        // Assert - Build and resolve to trigger factory execution
        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var imageService = serviceProvider.GetKeyedService<IImageToTextService>(null);

        // Verify the service was registered (GetService<ILoggerFactory>() was called)
        Assert.NotNull(imageService);
        Assert.IsType<HuggingFaceImageToTextService>(imageService);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddHuggingFaceImageToText_WithAllParameters_CallsGetServiceOnServiceProvider()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var mockLoggerFactory = new TestLoggerFactory();
        services.AddSingleton<ILoggerFactory>(mockLoggerFactory);

        // Act
        services.AddHuggingFaceImageToText(
            model: "gpt-image-model",
            endpoint: new Uri("https://huggingface.co/test"),
            apiKey: "test-api-key",
            serviceId: "test-service",
            httpClient: new HttpClient());

        // Assert - Build triggers the factory lambda which calls serviceProvider.GetService<ILoggerFactory>()
        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var imageService = serviceProvider.GetKeyedService<IImageToTextService>("test-service");

        Assert.NotNull(imageService);
        Assert.IsType<HuggingFaceImageToTextService>(imageService);
        Assert.True(mockLoggerFactory.WasAccessed); // Confirms GetService was called
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddHuggingFaceImageToText_WithNoLoggerFactoryAvailable_StillRegistersService()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();

        // Act
        services.AddHuggingFaceImageToText("test-model");

        // Assert - Should not throw when GetService<ILoggerFactory>() returns null
        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var imageService = serviceProvider.GetKeyedService<IImageToTextService>(null);

        Assert.NotNull(imageService);
        Assert.IsType<HuggingFaceImageToTextService>(imageService);
    }

    // Helper class to verify ILoggerFactory was resolved via GetService
    private sealed class TestLoggerFactory : ILoggerFactory
    {
        public bool WasAccessed { get; private set; }

        public void AddProvider(ILoggerProvider provider) => throw new NotImplementedException();
        public ILogger CreateLogger(string categoryName) => throw new NotImplementedException();
        public void Dispose() { }

        public bool WasAccessed
        {
            get
            {
                WasAccessed = true;
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
}

{
    [Fact]
    public void AddHuggingFaceImageToText_WithModel_RegistersService()

        // Arrange

        // Act

        // Assert

        var imageService = serviceProvider.GetKeyedService<IImageToTextService>(null);
        Assert.NotNull(imageService);
        Assert.IsType<HuggingFaceImageToTextService>(imageService);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddHuggingFaceImageToText_WithEndpoint_RegistersService()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();

        // Act
        services.AddHuggingFaceImageToText(new Uri("https://test-endpoint.com"));

        // Assert
        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var imageService = serviceProvider.GetKeyedService<IImageToTextService>(null);
        Assert.NotNull(imageService);
        Assert.IsType<HuggingFaceImageToTextService>(imageService);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddHuggingFaceImageToText_WithServiceId_RegistersKeyedService()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        const string serviceId = "test-service";

        // Act
        services.AddHuggingFaceImageToText("test-model", serviceId: serviceId);

        // Assert
        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var imageService = serviceProvider.GetKeyedService<IImageToTextService>(serviceId);

        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var expectedLoggerFactory = NullLoggerFactory.Instance;
        services.AddSingleton<ILoggerFactory>(expectedLoggerFactory);

        // Act
        services.AddHuggingFaceImageToText("test-model");

        // Assert - Building triggers factory execution which calls serviceProvider.GetService<ILoggerFactory>()
        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var imageService = serviceProvider.GetKeyedService<IImageToTextService>(null);
        Assert.NotNull(imageService);
        Assert.IsType<HuggingFaceImageToTextService>(imageService);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddHuggingFaceImageToText_NoLoggerFactoryAvailable_StillRegistersService()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();

        // Act
        services.AddHuggingFaceImageToText("test-model");

        // Assert - serviceProvider.GetService<ILoggerFactory>() returns null, but service still created
        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var imageService = serviceProvider.GetKeyedService<IImageToTextService>(null);
        Assert.NotNull(imageService);
        Assert.IsType<HuggingFaceImageToTextService>(imageService);
    }
